title: Foundry-lite Action Types v2 parity matrix
scope: Promote the single-object setProperty action executor into a general Ontology transaction + agent-native action platform (typed IR, multi-object/link atomic edit plan, function-backed edits, typed parameters/forms/criteria, governed side effects, action log, revert, branch/scenario, interface actions, SDK/API/UI/MCP distribution).

statusDefinitions.foundation: Base model or port exists, but no end-to-end runtime behavior.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some implementation exists but a required proof, surface, or live/E2E evidence is absent.
statusDefinitions.current: Implementation + repository/contract tests + live/E2E + SDK evidence all present.

reusedStrengths: ActionMutationUnitOfWork.commit (action_mutations.py:42) is a per-object commit primitive already looped over many objects by ActionBatchService inside one transaction.
CAS: update_object_target WHERE object_version==expected + object_records_version append; status_cas.cas_status_transition WHERE status IN from_statuses.
Transactional outbox + masked audit + run_relation via runtime_service evidence boundary.
safe_expression.py: eval-free precondition grammar with a robust hand-written tokenizer.
External-writeback three-phase before-commit saga (external_pending WAL, AMBIGUOUS-never-failure, reconcile) — the substrate for gating side effects.
OSDK resource-scope authorization (domain/platform/scopes.py + require_resource_scope) enforced across function/action/object services.
SDK codegen (scripts/sdk_generator/*) with a byte-exact --check drift gate wired into the static lane, plus check_frontend_backend_surface.py.
Real runtime hooks to connect to: FunctionExecutionService, interface conformance validation, ontology branch snapshot/proposal-merge.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: An action type is a typed set of rules (createObject, modifyObject(s), createOrModifyObject, deleteObject(s), createLink, deleteLink, function edit, interface variants) each with a stable identity and evaluation order; rule value sources are parameter, object-reference property, static, and contextual (current user / current timestamp).
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: action_types.definition JSON carries mutations[] limited to {type:'setProperty', property, value|valueFrom}; ACTION_MUTATION_TYPES=frozenset({'setProperty'}); valueFrom resolves only params.<key>.
capabilities.targetBehavior: A typed Action IR v2 with all rule kinds, stable ruleId + explicit order, and a validated value-expression AST covering every value source (no eval, no string interpolation). v1 setProperty definitions normalize to a v2 modifyObject rule at compile time (dual-read).
capabilities.remainingGap: The typed IR (all rule kinds + eval-free value-expression AST), ordering/exclusivity validation, and the v1->v2 normalizing compiler are complete and now consumed by the live apply path (commit ac0e2a05): a rulesV2 action authored in ontology YAML compiles and runs through foundry.actions.apply, proven by the FulfillOrder E2E. FunctionEditRule is parsed into the IR but its execution is deferred to function-backed-actions; prior-rule output as a value position (vs a link endpoint) and webhook/function value sources are deferred.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Rules compile into a deterministic per-object edit; multiple rules touching the same property resolve by order; invalid orderings (delete-before-add, modify-before-add, double-create) fail at compile time; all edits commit atomically on submission.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: The 'plan' is an implicit list of setProperty patches; ActionMutationUnitOfWork commits one object; ActionBatchService loops it over same-type targets sharing one patch. No structured EditPlan object.
capabilities.targetBehavior: An immutable EditPlan (objectsToCreate/Modify/Delete, linksToCreate/Delete, readSetVersions, expectedWriteVersions, stableOperationKeys, originatingRuleIds, provenance, permission evidence, redacted parameter snapshot, sideEffectPlan) built, validated, then committed as a separate stage.
capabilities.remainingGap: The immutable EditPlan, whole-plan validator, ordered IR->plan builder, ActionEditPlanCommitter, and the live LivePlanResolutionContext adapter run end to end on the real apply path (commit ac0e2a05). Deferred: function-rule planning (raises today), prior-rule output as a property value, and objectSet resolution is minimal (list-of-ids).

capabilities.palantirBehavior: One action can create/modify/delete objects of multiple types and create/delete many-to-many links, committing all Ontology edits all-or-nothing; foreign-key (one-to-many) links are set by modifying the object's foreign-key property, not a link rule.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: ActionRepository exposes only update_object_target (CAS) + insert_object_edit (edit_type='set_property'); no object create/delete and no action-facing link create/delete. Single target_object_type is hard-coded.
capabilities.targetBehavior: A transactional committer that applies a heterogeneous EditPlan across object types and M:M links in one Postgres transaction with per-edit CAS, stable create IDs, link uniqueness/cardinality checks, dangling-link prevention, tenant guard, audit+outbox+idempotency, and stale-plan rejection.
capabilities.remainingGap: Live-proven and hardened: the FulfillOrder rulesV2 action modifies its target Order, creates a second Order, and links them in one transaction with read-your-writes, one action run + per-object edit rows, idempotent replay, action-role permission denial, and stale-version conflict rollback (commits ac0e2a05 + review fixes). An adversarial review then closed an OCC lost-update window (the target CAS now binds to the client-validated expectedObjectVersion) and a link-endpoint visibility hole (endpoints resolve through the same row/segment visibility check as modify/delete), with regression tests in test_action_plan_resolution.py; repository primitives are SQLite+PG contract-tested. Deferred deltas: per-object-type SEGMENT-mask edit-through enforcement (row visibility + action-level Apply are enforced), and external side effects on the v2 path (writeback/function rules).

capabilities.palantirBehavior: A function rule (mutually exclusive with all other rules) delegates all edits to an ontology edit function that returns a typed edit batch; the action engine applies it; the function itself never writes; function version is pinned.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: FunctionExecutionService runs a persisted Logic DAG, read/compute-only, gated on role + OSDK function:execute scope + input validation. It does not produce or apply an ontology edit batch.
capabilities.targetBehavior: A function rule whose result is a typed OntologyEditBatch re-validated (schema, existence, permissions, tenant, constraints, version, limits, sensitive-field policy) and applied only by the edit-plan committer, with function apiName/version pinned and deterministic operation keys.
capabilities.remainingGap: The version-pinned Logic DAG adapter returns an OntologyEditBatch that is revalidated and committed once through the fenced Temporal Action run. It remains partial until the complete Builder/Python SDK/browser path and broader Functions program are proven.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Parameters are typed (string/boolean/integer/long/double/decimal/date/timestamp/object/objectSet/attachment/geohash/geoshape/mediaReference/marking/struct/array), individually form-exposed and editable, with static / object-property / type-class defaults; one canonical schema drives server validation, SDK, form, and MCP input schema.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: parameter_schema is a JSON-Schema subset; safe_expression validates required/unknown/typed params limited to string/integer/float/boolean; defaults are absent; the ActionFormPanel renders scalar inputs.
capabilities.targetBehavior: An extensible typed parameter schema with the full type set, defaults (static/object-property/type-class), and one canonical schema generating server validation + TS SDK + browser form + MCP tool input schema.
capabilities.remainingGap: The canonical contract now supports primitive/date/timestamp/decimal/object/interface/objectSet/array/struct/media/attachment parameters and deterministic defaults/JSON Schema. Runtime UI form, generated Python SDK, and MCP tool schema are not yet complete, so this stays partial.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Conditional overrides modify a parameter's visibility/requiredness/default/constraints; first-matching block wins; conditions reference only parameters above in the form hierarchy.
capabilities.targetBehavior: Typed conditional overrides evaluated first-match-wins with an above-in-hierarchy reference constraint, shared with submission-criteria condition model.
capabilities.remainingGap: First-match overrides and earlier-parameter-only references are compiler/runtime tested. Builder rendering and browser evidence remain absent.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Submission criteria combine nestable ALL/ANY/NONE with comparison operators over parameters, object properties, linked-object attributes, and current-user identity/group/attributes; evaluated at submit; block submission with a per-condition failure message; independent of data permissions.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: safe_expression preconditions support only == 'literal' and in [list] over string-coerced values; no boolean composition, numeric comparison, negation, or user/group operands.
capabilities.targetBehavior: A typed Boolean submission-criteria AST (all/any/not; equals/notEquals/in/notIn/gt/gte/lt/lte/contains/matches/exists; parameter, object-property, current-user/group/attribute operands) evaluated server-side and generated for the client from one schema.
capabilities.remainingGap: Nested all/any/not and typed parameter/object/current-user operands now execute server-side. Linked-object operands, generated client evaluator, and browser explanations remain to be proven.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Distinct View/Edit/Apply permissions; applying uses the submitting user's own permissions so an action cannot edit unseen objects/links; effective access is the intersection of user identity/role/group, object/link/action-type policy, OSDK app scope, and MCP scope; submission criteria are an independent gate.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: PolicyService RBAC with action:execute:<name> roles (fail-closed), object:read target guard, property masking (classification/segment), not-found masking (visible_record), segment_mutation_denied_error. OSDK resource-scope enforced for function/action.
capabilities.targetBehavior: The same intersection extended to every v2 edit: per-edited-object/link read+edit checks in the plan validator, function-execute and side-effect-execute permissions, sensitive-parameter and high-risk-approval gates, uniform not-found masking.
capabilities.remainingGap: Plans now intersect Action, target, per-edit object/link/property, function, connector and OSDK application scope, and high-risk approvals recheck plan/version drift. MCP token-scope intersection and full browser permission evidence remain incomplete.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: A single before-commit (gating) webhook runs before rule evaluation; if it fails no Ontology change is made; its output can feed subsequent rules.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: The external-writeback saga (external_pending WAL, receipt, outcome_unknown/compensation_required/reconciled) is the before-commit external-call substrate, but only an S3 adapter exists and the target URI is caller-supplied (not action-owned).
capabilities.targetBehavior: A before-commit gating webhook owned by the action definition (approved connector/resource only), whose durable receipt integrates the existing outcome_unknown/compensation_required/reconciliation paths and whose response fields are a rule value source.
capabilities.remainingGap: A v3 Action owns one registered-connector before webhook; a durable fenced receipt is written before dispatch, SSRF/inline URI are blocked, known failure prevents commit, and ambiguous delivery closes outcome_unknown without replay. Using response fields as rule values, reconciliation UI, and live multi-worker effect takeover are still incomplete.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Multiple after-commit side effects (webhook, notification, event, schedule/build trigger, connector command) fire after edits are applied, unordered, possibly async; their failure does not roll back the edits.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: action_types.definition carries sideEffects[] but no executor; the transactional outbox (at-least-once, lease reclaim, DLQ) delivers action.run.committed/object.changed only.
capabilities.targetBehavior: Action-owned after-commit side effects delivered via the outbox with stable idempotency keys, retry classification, bounded backoff, dead-letter/operator evidence, delivery receipts, secret redaction, and network policy; notifications rendered against pre-edit state.
capabilities.remainingGap: After-commit effects now create transactionally paired outbox events and per-effect receipts, then deliver with stable idempotency, retry/DLQ/outcome_unknown, lease takeover, fencing, connector/network/secret policy and tenant RLS. Visual receipt/DLQ controls, recipient object-access filtering, cancellation, and real two-worker effect takeover remain incomplete.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: An action submission is a durable, auditable unit with terminal and recovery states.
capabilities.targetBehavior: The existing state machine extended (validating/planned/queued/running/commit_pending as needed) for multi-object and asynchronous function/side-effect execution without duplicating states.
capabilities.remainingGap: Durable queued/running/cancelling/commit_pending/terminal runs, steps, attempts, events, cancellation, lease takeover and fenced exact-one commit are live-proven. Log/revert/effect monitoring and full browser evidence remain incomplete.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Each submission creates exactly one action log object foreign-key-linked to all edited objects, recording action RID/type/version, timestamp, user, edited object PKs, optional summary/parameter values; queryable via the Ontology, links, aggregations, and a timeline widget.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: action_runs + object_edits capture every v2 object and many-to-many link edit per run; repository reads return one run's ordered edit set and the latest edit touching an object. There is still no single action-log object projection linked to every edited object nor an Ontology-queryable timeline.
capabilities.targetBehavior: A durable action log (one record per submission) linked to every edited object/link, capturing full provenance, redacted parameters, side-effect receipts, and branch context, exposed as an Ontology-queryable read model.
capabilities.remainingGap: The current durable ledger now includes create/modify/delete object edits and create/delete link edits with tenant-scoped run/latest queries. Still absent: one Ontology-queryable action-log object per submission, object-set linkage/aggregations, timeline UI, side-effect receipts, and branch context. Slice 7.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Revert is allowed only if the edit is still the latest version, no later edit touched the object, the edit is reversible, and the caller has revert rights; it undoes object edits only, never side effects.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: object_records_version history exists; no revert specification or service.
capabilities.targetBehavior: A revert eligibility specification and service that restores object/link edits when still-latest and unconflicted, records a new action log, and never claims to undo already-emitted side effects (issuing a compensating action instead when needed).

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Actions can execute on a branch/scenario as an isolated edit overlay that never merges to main, with side effects suppressed by default and per-effect opt-in.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: OntologyBranchService provides isolated definition edits + proposal-merge, but actions are not executable against a branch overlay.
capabilities.targetBehavior: Branch/scenario action execution against an isolated edit overlay with dry-run/preview returning the redacted edit plan and impacted objects/links, conflict checks before merge, side effects suppressed by default, and a production action log after merge.
capabilities.remainingGap: No branch-scoped object edit overlay for actions, no action dry-run/preview surface. Slice 8.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Interface actions modify only interface shared properties or delete objects (not concrete/type-specific properties, not primary keys) and re-validate per implementing object type uniformly.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: interface_types + query_by_interface + conformance validation exist; no interface-scoped action rules.
capabilities.targetBehavior: Interface-scoped action rules (interface reference parameter, shared-property-only edits) re-validating each implementing type's constraints and permissions.
capabilities.remainingGap: No interface rule kind or per-implementer re-validation for edits. Slice 8.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: Actions are distributed through list/get, schema/form metadata, validate, plan/dry-run, apply, run get/list, events, cancel, action log, revert-eligibility, revert, and branch execution across API and typed SDK.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: 3 action routes (apply/apply-batch/validate); TS SDK generated from one ontology YAML with a byte-exact drift gate; Python OSDK hand-authored.
capabilities.targetBehavior: Extended action API + generated TS/Python SDK covering plan/dry-run, multi-object apply, run get/list, events, cancel, action log, revert, and branch execution, with SDK drift failing when the action contract changes.
capabilities.remainingGap: Catalog/get/schema/plan/dry-run plus durable run start/list/get/events/cancel and typed TS/browser SDK surfaces exist, including effect receipts without lease-token exposure. Logs/revert/branch APIs, complete generated Python SDK, runtime/history UI and browser proof remain incomplete.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: A visual Action Type builder, a runtime action form auto-rendered from the canonical schema (conditional visibility/default/required, object reference picker, permission-aware dropdown, validation, dry-run impact preview, idempotent submit, version-conflict handling), and an action history view.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: apps/foundry/src/features/actions renders scalar apply/batch/validate forms consuming the SDK react hooks; Workshop RuntimeActionForm consumes the same SDK.
capabilities.targetBehavior: Builder + runtime form + history that render from the canonical v2 schema and preview a real dry-run edit plan.
capabilities.remainingGap: No builder, conditional rendering, object picker filters, dry-run preview, or history view for v2. Slice 9.

capabilities.palantirBehavior: An Ontology MCP server exposes object-type query and action validate/plan/apply (and approved functions) as MCP tools/resources, authorized by the intersection of application scope and the calling principal's permissions, with high-risk actions gated plan->approval->apply.
capabilities.foundryLiteBaseline: No MCP server exists; OSDK resource-scope authorization and the action service it would call do exist.
capabilities.targetBehavior: An MCP server that maps each Action Type to a deterministic tool schema and calls the same action service, enforcing app-scope ∩ principal permission and a plan->approval->apply boundary for high-risk actions.
capabilities.remainingGap: Entire MCP server, tool-schema mapping, and approval boundary absent. Slice 10.
